rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Peladits tinggi kurus hitam arang berbulu tebal seperti beruang, melompat sambil melolong.

visual_requirements.description: Sosok sangat tinggi kurus hitam arang, seluruh tubuh berbulu seperti beruang; satu kepala dua lengan dua kaki.
Lompatan dan lolongan; debu terangkat karena kontak kaki, tanpa kekuatan gaib baru.

aura: Ancaman dari tubuh kurus hitam berbulu c02 dan lolongan sambil melompat c03.
artistic_choices: Tidak ada anak, korban, alat penyiksaan atau adegan kekerasan; subjek sendirian.
Wajah ditafsir sebagai humanoid kurus berbulu, tidak menambahkan kepala beruang: sumber hanya menyebut bulu seperti beruang.
Cahaya bulan samping dan pijakan batu editorial; tidak ada kekuatan gaib tercatat yang divisualkan.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Peladits, the sinister Catalan bogey hiding near Mount Montserrat.
ANATOMY: one exceptionally tall and very thin humanoid with coal-black skin hidden beneath thick shaggy bear-like black hair; one narrow humanoid head, two eyes, two long arms, two long legs, normal five-fingered hands. He is NOT a bear: the hair alone is bear-like [peladits-c02]. Dense opaque fur covers the entire body.
MOMENT: LEAPING down from a rocky ledge toward the viewer, knees sharply bent, arms thrown outward for balance, narrow mouth wide open in a raw howl; body twists dynamically, face confronts camera [peladits-c03].
POWER: no documented magical power used; movement flings ordinary stone dust from the ledge.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle close view, the tall thin silhouette fills the square with head near upper edge; recognizable lanky anatomy, no invented mountain-sized giant.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one hard moonbeam outlines the long shaggy body against deep walnut darkness, tiny dust grains.
SURFACE: coarse matted coal-black hair, narrow sinewy hands, rough rock.
SETTING: rocky hiding place near Mount Montserrat, distant serrated mountain silhouette unobtrusive [peladits-c01].
MOOD: menacing and feral, dangerous and imposing, never cute or static.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no children or other people, no harm or gore, no tools of torture; no horns, wings, animal head or extra limbs; no text, logo, frame, border or watermark; no borrowed modern design; no nudity; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.

visual_review.notes: Native dan 200px: sosok hitam kurus berbulu mendominasi, melompat sambil melolong; satu kepala, dua lengan dua kaki, tanpa anatomi tambahan. Tidak ada korban/anak/gore/efek gaib karangan. Tujuh Uji Sangar ya.
